notes.title: Build the city of your dreams! Celestial Empire NOW AVAILABLE in Early Access
notes.notes: [p]Constructors![/p][p]The wait is over – [b]Celestial Empire has officially launched in Early Access with a 12% release discount![/b] Step into the role of a provincial governor in a mystical land in ancient China, where every decision shapes the future of your people. [b]Add it to your library now![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38094144/63789a02942399a220bcf8f367e892cc2fa6db96.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]ABOUT EARLY ACCESS[/b][/h3][p]Early Access release covers all the basics and promised content of the game, which will be regularly updated and developed. It is expected to last for about a year, including its players in the Celestial Empire’s development. Grab a Steam key and prepare to build the city of your dreams![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330430/Celestial_Empire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]UPDATE ROADMAP[/b][/h3][p]And this is just the beginning! We have an exciting roadmap of upcoming updates planned to expand and enrich your experience in the Celestial Empire. Your journey in the Celestial Empire will only grow richer with time. Check out our update roadmap![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38094144/d2a0256ac8e4152df7135c8e02108901fce72080.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]HELP & BUG REPORTS[/b][/h3][p]If you have any problems with your game or see any bugs, please do not hesitate to contact us via discord (that's the place where we will be able to reply the fastest), steam discussions or the following address e-mail: [url="https://help@president-studio.com"]help@president-studio.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_KVFj9t2z-Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting us through development – your feedback and passion made this day possible. 💖[/p][p][/p][p]Can't wait to see your marvelous cities![/p][p][i]The Devs[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Release date – Celestial Empire coming out SOON!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Governors![/b][/p][p]The wait is finally over! After months of anticipation, questions, and curiosity, we can proudly share the long-awaited news. [b]We officially announce that Celestial Empire will launch in Early Access on September 23rd, 2025, 11:00 UTC![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38094144/58a261570d2bfc3bdd43c955daa59207a0cdfe15.png"][/img][/p][p]The Early Access release covers all the core features and promised content of the game, with regular updates and expansions planned along the way. Our Early Access journey is expected to last about a year, during which we want you – the players – to be an essential part of [i]Celestial Empire’s[/i] growth and development.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="lN7aIRUTxq0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]So, mark your calendars, add the game to your wishlist (if you haven’t done it already [i]ekhm ekhm[/i]), and get ready to build the city of your dreams![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330430/Celestial_Empire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]With hand-crafted maps, stunning natural landscapes, and detailed architecture inspired by ancient China, [i]Celestial Empire[/i] offers a unique city-building experience crafted with care. Will you prove worthy of the title [b]The Great Governor[/b]?
[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support – we can’t wait for you to join us in shaping the Empire together. September 23rd is just the beginning! Got some questions? Check out our discord![/p][p][/p][p][url=https://discord.com/invite/h5eR6vbPXS][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38094144/cead38c511a75b05f145acb7e1199dbfa8dd5be4.png"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: Your empire start awaits – play Celestial Empire: Prologue for free!
notes.notes: [p]The wait is over, Governor – the first chapter of your dynasty begins! [b]Celestial Empire: Prologue[/b] will be live on Steam on [b]September 10th 2025, 11:00 UTC[/b] and ready for you to explore. Remember to add the full game to your library to stay updated![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330430/Celestial_Empire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="justify"]In this [b]free introduction[/b] to our Ancient China–themed city builder, you’ll:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Build the very first foundations of your city[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Lead your people and make sure they prosper[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Soak in the unique atmosphere of ancient Chinese landscapes[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Get a taste of the grand journey that awaits in the full game[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"][/p][previewyoutube="lN7aIRUTxq0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p align="justify"]The prologue is your chance to see if the world of [i]Celestial Empire[/i] is the right place for your story to unfold. Try it now, get to know the mechanics, and decide if you want to continue your adventure in the full version once it’s released. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]We really encourage you to [b]leave your reviews on the prologue's Steam page[/b]. Feedback is very valuable for us, as we would really like to make the best city-builder ever. That’s where your opinions come in handy![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]No barriers, no limits – just download, play, and begin shaping the legacy of your empire![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38094144/cead38c511a75b05f145acb7e1199dbfa8dd5be4.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p]
